title: Rook CephFilesystem
description: Schema for the Rook CephFilesystem Custom Resource Definition, which provisions CephFS shared file storage on Kubernetes. CephFilesystem defines metadata and data pool configurations, metadata server (MDS) settings, and volume snapshot scheduling for a POSIX-compliant shared filesystem that supports ReadWriteMany access from multiple pods.

apiVersion.description: Kubernetes API version for the CephFilesystem resource

name.description: Name of the CephFilesystem resource, also used as the CephFS filesystem name

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the filesystem resource is deployed

labels.description: Key-value labels for organizing and selecting Kubernetes resources

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for storing non-identifying metadata

CephFilesystemSpec.description: Specification for the CephFilesystem including metadata pool, data pools, and MDS configuration

metadataPool.description: Configuration for the CephFS metadata pool storing filesystem directory structure and file metadata

dataPools.description: List of data pool configurations where CephFS file content is stored. Multiple data pools allow tiering across different storage classes.

metadataServer.description: Configuration for the CephFS Metadata Server (MDS) daemons

preserveFilesystemOnDelete.description: If true, the CephFS filesystem data is preserved when the CephFilesystem CRD is deleted. If false, the filesystem and all data are permanently deleted.

statusCheck.description: Settings for the periodic health check of the filesystem

mirror.description: Health check settings for filesystem mirroring

disabled.description: Whether the mirroring health check is disabled

interval.description: Interval for the mirroring health check (e.g. 60s)

mirroring.description: CephFS filesystem mirroring configuration for disaster recovery

secretNames.description: Kubernetes Secret names with bootstrap tokens for remote cluster peers

snapshotSchedules.description: Snapshot schedules for filesystem mirroring synchronization

path.description: CephFS path to apply the snapshot schedule to

startTime.description: Start time for the snapshot schedule

path.description: CephFS path the retention policy applies to

PoolSpec.description: Configuration for a Ceph pool used by the filesystem

failureDomain.description: Failure domain for spreading data across for fault tolerance

deviceClass.description: OSD device class this pool should use

size.description: Number of replicas for data redundancy

requireSafeReplicaSize.description: Prevent creation of pools with unsafe replication factors

dataChunks.description: Number of data chunks in the erasure coding stripe

NamedPoolSpec.description: A named Ceph pool configuration for filesystem data storage

name.description: Name suffix for the data pool. The full pool name will be {filesystem-name}-{name}.

failureDomain.description: Failure domain for the data pool

deviceClass.description: OSD device class for the data pool

MetadataServerSpec.description: Configuration for the CephFS Metadata Server (MDS) daemon that manages filesystem namespace operations

activeCount.description: Number of active MDS instances. Additional standby MDS daemons are started for failover. Production deployments should use at least 1.

activeStandby.description: If true, standby MDS daemons pre-warm their cache by following the active MDS journal, allowing faster failover

annotations.description: Kubernetes annotations to add to the MDS daemon pods

labels.description: Kubernetes labels to add to the MDS daemon pods

resources.description: CPU and memory resource requests and limits for MDS daemon pods

priorityClassName.description: Priority class name for the MDS daemon pods

placement.description: Kubernetes placement settings for MDS pods including nodeSelector, tolerations, and affinity

livenessProbe.description: Kubernetes liveness probe configuration for MDS daemon containers

startupProbe.description: Kubernetes startup probe configuration for MDS daemon containers

CephFilesystemStatus.description: Observed state of the CephFilesystem as reported by the Rook operator

phase.description: Current lifecycle phase of the filesystem

conditions.description: Conditions representing the current state of the filesystem

lastChecked.description: Time of the last mirroring status check

daemonsStatus.description: Status of individual mirroring daemon instances

snapshotScheduleStatus.description: Status of snapshot schedules configured for mirroring

Condition.description: A Kubernetes-style condition for the filesystem resource

lastTransitionTime.description: Time when the condition last changed
